selection_rule: k % 7 == 0 ascending in [1..2000], excluding every seed in the r53-r56 history, the R57 TRAIN/VAL, the retired R57/R58/R59 TEST sets, the recorded R58 dev seeds, the family, and every multiple of 3 or 4 below 250 (the prior split residues); first 40

retirement: after the R61 final validation these seeds are retired permanently (never trained on, never used for selection again)
